content.title: Speaking Test 9 — Food
content.description: The full three-part interview: food and cooking in Part 1, a long turn on “Describe a meal you would like to share with your friends”, then a discussion of eating habits and the food industry.

prompts.promptHtml:
Let's talk about food and cooking.

What kinds of food do you like to eat? [Why?]
Do you ever cook for yourself? [Why/Why not?]
Has the food you eat changed since you were a child? [Why/Why not?]
Do you prefer eating at home or eating out? [Why?]
Describe a meal you would like to share with your friends.
bulletsHtml: and explain why you would choose this meal

prompts.promptHtml:
Let's consider eating habits.

How have eating habits changed in your country in recent years?
Why do some people find it hard to eat healthily?
Do you think families should always try to eat together?

Let's consider the food industry.

What effect do large supermarkets have on small food shops?
Should governments control the advertising of unhealthy food?
Do you think people will eat more or less meat in the future?
